newsitem.title: UK: Britain send naval vessel to Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: Britain send naval vessel to Sierra Leone.

text.p: Britain said on Tuesday it was sending a naval support vessel to Sierra Leone as United States helicopters evacuated foreigners from the strife-torn West African state.
The 28,000-ton Argus, which carries Sea King helicopters and is equipped with a casualty receiving centre, will take up station offshore when it arrives later this week.
A ministry of defence spokesman said the Argus was being sent to the area as a "prudent, precautionary measure".
"The Argus is sailing towards Sierra Leone where she will be on standby," the spokesman said.
The latest round of evacuations coincides with fears of further violence in Sierra Leone after an army coup nine days ago which ousted democratically elected President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah.
